# lib/ - generated, do not edit

Copied from the main [20_Below](https://github.com/feralucce/20_Below) repo by
`scripts/sync-playsheet.mjs`, laid out the way `app/` is. Edit the originals
there and re-run the sync; anything changed here is overwritten.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `ui.js` | `app/ui.js` |
| `state.js` | `app/state.js` |
| `roller/core.js` | `app/roller/core.js` |
| `roller/damage.js` | `app/roller/damage.js` |
| `roller/giftCheck.js` | `app/roller/giftCheck.js` |
| `roller/resourceCheck.js` | `app/roller/resourceCheck.js` |
| `steps/roller-panel.js` | `app/steps/roller-panel.js` |
| `sheet/sheet-model.js` | `app/sheet/sheet-model.js` |
| `sheet/panels.js` | `app/sheet/panels.js` |
| `steps/tab-advancement.js` | `app/steps/tab-advancement.js` |
| `steps/07-boons.js` | `app/steps/07-boons.js` |
| `describe-spec.js` | `app/describe-spec.js` |
| `bug-report.js` | `app/bug-report.js` |
| `marked.min.js` | `vendor/marked.min.js` |
